originalTitle: GM can’t ‘bring back’ Apple CarPlay because it never left

content: Last week, GM announced a new software experience for its upcoming Chevy Silverado and GMC Sierra trucks, including a new look for Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, the popular phone mirroring systems that the automaker made a big deal about removing from its electric vehicles in 2023. Naturally, this led to some confusion about whether GM was “bringing back” CarPlay and Android Auto to its vehicles. Yahoo Finance reported it that way, calling it an “about-face” by the automaker, while Apple Insider’s headline boasted that GM “cave[d]” on its decision to remove the interface from its gas-powered vehicles. Even The Verge’s own commenters were a bit flummoxed about what was going on. It’s certainly true that GM has not offered phone projection in any of its electric vehicles for the past three years. That means no CarPlay or Android Auto in the Chevy Equinox, Blazer, Bolt, and Silverado EVs; Cadillac Lyriq, Optiq, Vistiq, and Escalade IQ; or GMC Sierra and Hummer SUV and Truck EVs. All of those vehicles have Google software products embedded in their systems, like Maps and Gemini. That’s because GM builds its operating system on top of Android Automotive, which is often called Google Automotive Services or GAS when bundled with the full suite of native apps. But if you’re hoping to plug in your phone, or connect wirelessly, and see the familiar app layout on the infotainment screen of a GM electric vehicle, you’ll be sorely disappointed. The same can’t be said about GM’s many gas-powered trucks and SUVs. GM never disabled phone projection in its best-selling ICE models. Tens of thousands of owners of GM-branded vehicles regularly project their phones’ displays on their vehicles’ infotainment screens without any issue. And now CarPlay and Android Auto are both getting spiffy new picture-in-picture upgrades in the Chevy Silverado and GMC Sierra, a sign that perhaps GM is learning to co-exist with phone mirroring. GM is partly responsible for the confusion. In an October 2025 appearance on Decoder, GM CEO Mary Barra defended the company’s decision to prohibit CarPlay in its electric vehicles and indicated that the policy would eventually extend to GM’s gasoline-powered lineup as well. Everyone freaked out for a second time. Removing phone projection in EVs was one thing, but many truck and SUV owners were understandably incensed about the prospect of losing the capability in their beloved GM-branded vehicles. But a few days later, GM seemed to walk back that statement, clarifying to a number of outlets that Apple CarPlay and Android Auto would remain available in its gas-powered vehicles “for the foreseeable future.” Last week’s announcement of a new software experience in the Silverado and Sierra trucks would seem to be included in that “foreseeable future.” Allow me to add some further reporting here. For the Silverado/Sierra announcement, I spoke to Colin McCormick, group product manager for Google built-in, projection, and profiles at GM. Here’s what he had to say about how GM’s position on phone projection has evolved over the years: > And so the way that I look at this is that we were one of the early adopters of CarPlay and Android Auto when it first came out. And we do have a small segment of EVs right now that don’t offer that, but there is a large majority of our vehicles that do offer that. And our big position on this is that it shouldn’t be two competing systems. So as we work together with Apple and Google to provide solutions that we think are best for the customer, this is what we’re representing in this new UI design. So I think we’re landing in a spot where … we don’t have a customer that has to decide, ‘Oh, I’m going to use projection,’ or, ‘Oh, I want to use the native system.’ That’s our sweet spot for us. And that’s where we want to live. GM most likely realizes that its position on CarPlay and Android Auto isn’t popular. People really like mirroring their phones! It’s clean, it’s familiar, and it’s (mostly) dependable. The same can’t be said for most modern cars’ native software. Even the ones that are really well designed, like Rivian and Tesla, still struggle with some core functions like profile logins and messages. And you can find plenty of owners of both brands that would give their firstborn child for the ability to mirror their phone. CarPlay and Android Auto aren’t perfect. They have dependability problems and connectivity problems aplenty. But they are worlds better than the majority of the native operating systems in cars today — most of which are just trash. Yes, they’re getting better. And GM is not wrong in thinking it can offer a better experience. But people get testy when you take away their choices. So GM is finding ways to coexist with CarPlay and Android Auto. It doesn’t want to lose more customers over it, which is why we’re getting this most recent solution that includes picture-in-picture phone projection. GM thinks this solves the “two competing systems” problem, as mentioned by McCormick. But what it really does is get it out of the corner it backed itself into over phone mirroring.
chineseTitle: 通用汽车无法“带回”Apple CarPlay，因为它从未离开过
chineseSummary: 上周，通用汽车宣布为其即将推出的雪佛兰 Silverado 和 GMC Sierra 卡车提供新的软件体验，包括 Apple CarPlay 和 Android Auto 的新外观，这两种流行的手机镜像系统是该汽车制造商在 2023 年从其电动汽车中移除的重要内容。自然，这导致了一些关于是否 [...]
chineseContent: 上周，通用汽车宣布为其即将推出的雪佛兰 Silverado 和 GMC Sierra 卡车提供新的软件体验，其中包括 Apple CarPlay 和 Android Auto 的新外观，这两种流行的手机镜像系统是该汽车制造商在 2023 年从其电动汽车中移除的重要内容。自然，这导致人们对通用汽车是否将 CarPlay 和 Android Auto“带回”其车辆感到困惑。雅虎财经这样报道，称其为汽车制造商的“大转变”，而 Apple Insider 的头条则吹嘘通用汽车对从其汽油动力汽车上移除该接口的决定“犹豫不决”。就连 The Verge 自己的评论者也对正在发生的事情感到有点困惑。毫无疑问，过去三年通用汽车并未在其任何电动汽车中提供电话投影功能。这意味着雪佛兰 Equinox、Blazer、Bolt 和 Silverado 电动汽车中没有 CarPlay 或 Android Auto；凯迪拉克 Lyriq、Optiq、Vistiq 和 Escalade IQ；或 GMC Sierra 和悍马 SUV 以及卡车电动汽车。所有这些车辆的系统中都嵌入了谷歌软件产品，例如地图和双子座。这是因为通用汽车在 Android Automotive 之上构建了自己的操作系统，当与全套本机应用程序捆绑在一起时，该系统通常被称为 Google Automotive Services 或 GAS。但如果您希望插入手机或进行无线连接，并在通用汽车电动汽车的信息娱乐屏幕上看到熟悉的应用程序布局，您会非常失望。但通用汽车的许多汽油动力卡车和 SUV 却并非如此。通用汽车从未在其最畅销的 ICE 车型中禁用手机投影。数万名通用汽车品牌汽车的车主定期将手机显示屏投射到汽车的信息娱乐屏幕上，没有任何问题。现在 CarPlay 和 Android Auto 都变得越来越出色
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于 AI 与科技趋势信号，适合用于观察工具选型、产品机会、开发者关注点和技术路线变化。
